description_en: Queries the details of a sound code schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询声码排程详情
name: GetSoundCodeSchedule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

EndDate.description_en: The end date of the schedule

EndTime.description_en: The daily end time of the schedule
EndTime.description_zh: 排程每日结束工作时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the schedule was created

OpenType.description_en:
The open type of the schedule.

Internal (default): The value is INNER. Only devices within the instance where the schedule resides can request sound code decoding.

Public: The value is OPEN. You can configure a whitelist by sending emails to allow devices across instances to request sound code decoding. The usage of cross-instance decoding is calculated under the instance where the sound code resides
OpenType.description_zh:
排程开放类型。

内部（默认）：取值为INNER，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

公开：取值为OPEN，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下

ScheduleCode.description_en: The unique identifier of the schedule

StartDate.description_en: The start date of the schedule

StartTime.description_en: The daily start time of the schedule
StartTime.description_zh: 排程每日开始工作时间

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
